verdict.rationale: GitBook documents both a reader-facing 'AI Assistant' for conversational Q&A and a 'GitBook Agent' that can review change requests, and probes confirm a live, auth-gated organization-level MCP server that lets connected AI agents create sites, open change requests, and edit content via natural-language-driven tool calls (gitbook-probe-rt-3, gitbook-docs-18). This shows genuine agentic operation of the product beyond just search/read, but the write path is only confirmed to the OAuth challenge stage, not an end-to-end successful natural-language edit. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of a completed natural-language write action (e.g., an agent actually creating/editing content end-to-end) and clearer documentation of the AI Assistant performing actions rather than just answering questions.
